attchmntText: Mukand Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation for shifting of Corporate Office of  KFIN Technologies Limited, Registrar and Share Transfer Agent'.
voiceSummary: Mukand Limited intimates that KFIN Technologies Limited, the Registrar and Share Transfer Agent, will shift its Corporate Office effective December 01, 2026. The new address is 6, 23, 24, 25th Floor, South Tower, Rajapushpa West Avenue, Survey No. 115, Kokapet, Serilingampally Mandal, District - Ranga Reddy, Hyderabad, Telangana – 500075. All future correspondence, communications, notices, documents, and business-related communications to the Registrar and Share Transfer Agent must be addressed to this new Corporate Office from December 01, 2026. The Registered Office of the Registrar and Share Transfer Agent remains unchanged.

attchmntText: Mukand Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Mukand Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on November 12, 2026. The Board considered and approved the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The meeting commenced at 10.45 a.m. and concluded at 1.35 p.m. Shri Nirav Bajaj, Whole-time Director, is authorized to sign the Unaudited Financial Results. DHC & Co., Chartered Accountants, issued a Limited Review Report on the financial statements. The report states that nothing came to their attention to suggest material misstatements in the Standalone or Consolidated results. The Consolidated results include Mukand Sumi Metal Processing Limited, Mukand Heavy Engineering Limited, Hospet Steels Limited, and Bombay Forgings Limited. The financial results are available on the company website.
